## Classification and tested revision
Hosted reproducible test-compatibility defect, supported by exact source inspection; not evidence of a source-tracker mutation or migration failure.

PR [#168](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/pull/168), immutable head `fc39b4d35c22c5985085ba02231b911d90c9c3bd`, changes only package.json/package-lock.json: development SDK 2026.10.24→2026.10.25, pm-changelog .24→.25 and pm-ops .23→.24. Public exports, runtime dependencies, peer contract and scripts are unchanged (11 local static assertions passed; no local project runtime execution).

## Observed failure
Both current hosted lanes run 370 tests, with 368 passing and exactly two failing:
- [Node 22 job 122717044731](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/actions/runs/40659010490/job/122717044731)
- [Node 26 job 122717045072](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/actions/runs/40659010490/job/122717045072)

The failures are `CLI source isolation refuses omitted source after host startup` and `CLI source isolation refuses the active tracker after host startup`. Both stop at [`test/rehearsal.test.ts:472`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/blob/fc39b4d35c22c5985085ba02231b911d90c9c3bd/test/rehearsal.test.ts#L456-L482):

```ts
assert.equal(existsSync(join(host, "schema", "workflows.json")), true);
// actual false, expected true
```

The helper removes that file before invocation. Assertions before line 472 already pass: exit status 2; `invalid_plan` for omitted source or `unsafe_storage` for active source; required explicit-source guidance; no rehearsal work directory; no `source_unchanged` claim. The final independent-source byte comparison follows the failing assertion and is therefore not reached in these two cases; it must remain and run after repair.

## Expected behavior and accepted goal
[SDK #1568](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1568) is closed and the [SDK .25 release](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/releases/tag/v2026.10.25) includes its fix preventing read-only commands from recreating missing workflow schema files. Requiring recreation in the upgraded-host characterization now requires the previous side effect rather than the intended guarantee.

The existing accepted [schema-rehearsal PM item](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/blob/fc39b4d35c22c5985085ba02231b911d90c9c3bd/.agents/pm/features/pm-ts-starter-schema-rehearsal.toon) requires no original tracker modification, field diagnostics and once-only resumability. Keep the explicit independent-source boundary; do not weaken admission to make the tests green. The [README host-startup caveat](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/blob/fc39b4d35c22c5985085ba02231b911d90c9c3bd/README.md#L209-L219) and [runtime remedy](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/blob/fc39b4d35c22c5985085ba02231b911d90c9c3bd/rehearsal.ts#L125-L130) also merit version-accurate qualification, without claiming the extension can certify writes occurring before its own snapshot.

## Impact
The development toolchain upgrade is blocked on both supported hosted Node lanes even though the observed absent workflow file is consistent with the accepted read-only fix. This is not evidence that the underlying rehearsal corrupted data, that a released package regressed, or that every host-startup path is now write-free.

## Acceptance and regression criteria
- With pinned SDK .25, both omitted-source and active-source cases retain their typed refusals and explicit-source guidance, create no rehearsal work directory, and leave the deliberately missing workflow file absent.
- Reach and preserve the independent source byte-equality assertion; preferably assert caller-tree preservation as well for the bounded startup cases rather than relying only on one file.
- Retain the separate caller/source requirement, overlap and alias protection, and truthful receipt scope. If older supported SDKs intentionally remain covered, use an explicitly versioned characterization instead of a universal requirement for the old side effect.
- Qualify stale host-version caveats in test comments/docs/remedies; retain provenance of the historical SDK limitation.
- Re-run both Node22/26 full lanes, build/typecheck and relevant rehearsal/coverage gates; do not remove assertions, skip tests or change thresholds merely to pass.

Deduplication: all 168 current all-status issue/PR records and the existing canonical rehearsal item were checked. The only non-PR issues are unrelated closed #160 and #61. No overlapping issue was found. No PR comments, package changes, runtime tests against original checkouts, releases or deployments were performed for this review.
